body:
The Truth Shall Make You Free · Kente FM Radio · 2017-07-27 · Bishop Nathanyel

Opens [Matt 13](/bible/matthew/13) · [Col 2](/bible/colossians/2) · [Prov 3](/bible/proverbs/3) · [Prov 2](/bible/proverbs/2) · [John 14](/bible/john/14)
## Introduction *[[0:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TNU71cral7M&t=7s)]* The parable of the hidden treasure in Matthew 13:44: what is the hidden treasure? The precept in Colossians 2:3 and Proverbs shows it is wisdom and knowledge of scripture, understanding of God's commandments and his words, a treasure the world cannot receive. ## Scriptures Opened **[Matthew 13:44](/bible/matthew/13#v44)** *[[0:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TNU71cral7M&t=7s)]* > [44](/bible/matthew/13#v44) Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field. - **Host:** The parable of the hidden treasure, Matthew 13, because it uses the word hidden treasure. - So the question is, what is the hidden treasure? The precept: go to Colossians 2 and 3. **[Colossians 2:3](/bible/colossians/2#v3)** *[[1:31](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TNU71cral7M&t=91s)]* > [3](/bible/colossians/2#v3) In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge. - In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge: so the hidden treasure is wisdom and knowledge of scripture. That's what this parable is talking about. **[Proverbs 3:14-15](/bible/proverbs/3#v14)** *[[2:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TNU71cral7M&t=179s)]* > [14](/bible/proverbs/3#v14) For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold. > > [15](/bible/proverbs/3#v15) She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her. - They're talking about the wisdom of God. **[Proverbs 2:1-4](/bible/proverbs/2#v1)** *[[2:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TNU71cral7M&t=179s)]* > [1](/bible/proverbs/2#v1) My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee; > > [2](/bible/proverbs/2#v2) So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding; > > [3](/bible/proverbs/2#v3) Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding; > > [4](/bible/proverbs/2#v4) If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures; - If thou seekest her as silver and searchest for her as for hid treasures: so it's what the hid treasure is. It's God's commandments, understanding of his words. That is the hid treasure. - So when we go back to the parable now, we can read it and understand better what Christ is talking about in Matthew 13:44. **[Matthew 13:44](/bible/matthew/13#v44)** *[[4:09](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TNU71cral7M&t=249s)]* > [44](/bible/matthew/13#v44) Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field. - He's comparing that when you find this truth, you do all you can to get it, even if you … all that you have to learn it. You want this truth. - It's a treasure greater than rubies, greater than diamonds; that's what the Proverbs are saying also. - This is the hid treasure, because everybody cannot receive this. - **Host:** The reason why I chose this topic: I was holding a conversation with a Christian, and he came to visit me and he saw a lot of books, from Babylon to Timbuktu. He said, why do you have to spend so much time to buy all this and trying to learn what all is about? Just believing in Jesus. - **Host:** When you search for wisdom and understanding in the Bible, it goes also with a lot of books to substantiate the truth that we have found, because sometimes you say the truth and the people just want to disprove it. So sometimes you have to use your history books, you have to use your encyclopedia, you have to use whatever it takes to prove the wisdom that you have actually found in the testimony. **[John 14:17](/bible/john/14#v17)** *[[6:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TNU71cral7M&t=361s)]* > [17](/bible/john/14#v17) Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you. - That's what we remember in John 14 about the Holy Ghost; it goes back to what you're saying. - The world cannot receive the spirit of truth. So the comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, is the spirit of truth. - That ties in with the treasure hid in the field, which is understanding God's laws, understanding his words, his testimony. - The world can't receive it, the world, Christian friends, cannot receive it; they're like, why are you seeking the stuff out? What are you doing? Just believe in Jesus. - **Host:** Sometimes when they see you holding the Apocrypha: so what the hell, why all these? Even the one without Apocrypha we have actually not read it, so why do you want to use another book like the Apocrypha? Maybe you have not read it, but somebody has read all and tried to see the understanding and the wisdom in it. So what do you have to do? You have to soften your heart so that you also find out what is inside there. This is the problem. - Day before yesterday I did a show and the Christian said the same thing to me about the Apocrypha: he said you don't need it. He was a minister. So I took him to John chapter 10 and verse 22, the feast of the dedication, which is Hanukkah, and I asked him, explain that to me. He couldn't explain it; he said I don't know. I said that understanding is found in the book of Maccabees. - **Host:** We have a long way to go, but so far as the word of God is concerned I'm not going to keep my mouth shut; we continue to throw the challenge. More grease to your elbows: don't feel any kind of backwardness, keep on doing it, because the spirit is dwelling on you and disseminating this truth around the globe. Precepts: - **[John 10:22](/bible/john/10#v22)** > [22](/bible/john/10#v22) And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter. The feast of the dedication, which is Hanukkah: the minister who said you don't need the Apocrypha couldn't explain it, and that understanding is found in the book of Maccabees. ## In Closing *[[10:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TNU71cral7M&t=641s)]* Every IUIC event is on YouTube. Our mission: we must gather the saints. The internet, the web, is reaching hundreds of thousands to millions of our people, and it's going to grow exponentially. This truth is going to grow. The 12 tribes of Israel are being gathered together; they're being sealed with the testimony and the law in their minds, like it says in Revelation 7:4: the 144,000 are being sealed by hearing. Brothers and sisters, please join us, tune in every week, Lord's will. This truth is going to grow and grow and grow, so my prayer is that the Most High opens up the understanding of the listeners and has them join us and help us in his great venture, preparing our people for the second coming of the black Messiah called Jesus the Christ. ## Announcements & References - **Host:** My greetings to all the saints, especially Captain Isaac. - Subscribe to the Join IUIC YouTube channel to stay linked to all IUIC videos; YouTube shuts the channels down every so often. --- [Class Notes Index](/classes) · [Watch the full session on YouTube ↗](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TNU71cral7M)
